tool: exl3_launch_record.py, EXL3-G settings, on ExLlamaV3's extension built with the SDK's NVCC 13.4.92 (the EXL3 bridge build) and the SDK's cuBLAS 13.8.0.4 bind-mounted, on the frozen tuning caches of timing session aa; SASS hashes merged by sass_hashes.py merge (the scripted path; identical to the first merge)
matching: A native case matches when its ordered launches equal these: kernel name, grid, block, shared memory (static plus dynamic, as the PyTorch profiler reports it) and registers per thread; ExLlamaV3-derived kernels also by SASS hash (sass_sha256, from cuobjdump of the NVCC 13.4.92 extension, addresses stripped). cuBLAS kernels (nvjet_*, cutlass::*) are identified by name under the pinned cuBLAS 13.8.0.4. The bias add follows the native operation plan: ExLlamaV3's add_kernel_hhh on every path, not PyTorch's elementwise kernel.
interpretation: Upstream's kernel launches per BP-F2 case, in launch order. Supersedes the records made under PyTorch's cuBLAS 13.1.1 and under the NVCC 13.0.88 extension.
